title: Held-out leftover PPP clocks at full sky (no 3-D position)
product: precise IGS/MGEX receiver clocks = leftover time after production PPP
preprocessing: raw leftover PPP clocks; per-station bias is not kriged. TEP predicts the causal increment from other stations and adds it to the target hold. No full-day detrend, no network-mean removal.
note: If TEP beats persistence/AR1 here, 8+ satellites did not absorb the field: the leftover PPP clock still has TEP spatial structure. Position RMS at k>=4 is not this test.
